text.text: Designed specifically for flash, the AFF A-Series all-flash systems deliver industry-leading performance, capacity, density, scalability, security and network connectivity in dense form factors. With the addition of the new NVMe-based AFF A800, the AFF A-Series family extends enterprise-grade flash to AI and to machine learning. By combining low-latency NVMe solid-state drives (SSDs) and the first NVMe over Fibre Channel (NVMe/FC) connectivity, AFF A800 delivers below 200µs latency and a massive throughput of up to 300GB/s in a 24 node cluster.

text.text: AFF systems are excellent for performance-demanding applications and mixed-workload environments that consist of, for example: Oracle, Microsoft SQL Server, MongoDB databases, VDI, and server virtualization. And with the new end-to-end NVMe-based AFF A800, AFF is also a great choice for AI and deep-learning environments.

text.text: NetApp ONTAP 9 is the next generation of the industry's leading data management software. It combines new levels of simplicity and flexibility with powerful data management capabilities and storage efficiencies across flash, disk and cloud. It serves as the foundation for the NetApp Data Fabric, allowing customer access to their data wherever it resides. In addition to being available with all AFF systems, ONTAP is also packaged as a virtualized instance within public hyperscalers.
